tools.name: list_node_types
tools.description: Return the current allowed node-type catalog as structured JSON, together with the SCOPING PRINCIPLE that determines whether something should be a node at all. Read aiarchitect://rules/architecture-principles before calling this if you have not already.

streamSessionId.description: Required: session ID from the AI Architect web UI. Must be an active authenticated session.

tools.name: list_connection_types
tools.description: Return the current allowed connection-type catalog as structured JSON.

streamSessionId.description: Required: session ID from the AI Architect web UI. Must be an active authenticated session.

tools.name: canonical_edge_style
tools.description: Return the canonical edge.style block for a given connectionType. One of: default, async, sync, notification, rpc, stream, tcp.

streamSessionId.description: Required: session ID from the AI Architect web UI. Must be an active authenticated session.

tools.name: scaffold_blueprint
tools.description: Return schema-valid empty blueprint with one page. Always use this instead of hand-writing top-level JSON.

title.description: Blueprint title (stored in metadata.title; shown in the Blueprint Name field in the app).

pageName.description: Optional first page name override (defaults to "Page 1").

streamSessionId.description: Required: session ID from the AI Architect web UI. Must be an active authenticated session.

tools.name: scaffold_node
tools.description: Build complete node JSON with all required dimension/style fields and generates a unique id. Always use this instead of hand-writing. Notes support markdown. IMPORTANT: Use suggest_grid_position, suggest_horizontal_position, or suggest_vertical_position to calculate positions for clean layouts with proper spacing.

notes.description: Node description. Explain what it is, what it's responsible for, and what information it works with. Use 2-4 sentences or a short bulleted list. Supports markdown: actual newlines, `- ` for lists, **bold**, *italic*.

position.description: Node position. Use suggest_grid_position, suggest_horizontal_position, or suggest_vertical_position for proper spacing.

streamSessionId.description: Required: session ID from the AI Architect web UI. Must be an active authenticated session.

tools.name: scaffold_edge
tools.description: Build complete edge JSON with canonical style and handles, generates unique id. Always use this instead of hand-writing. Canvas caption comes from data.notes (3-8 words) or falls back to connectionType label if notes is omitted.

notes.description: Optional edge caption (3-8 words). This controls canvas display. Omit to show connection-type label.

streamSessionId.description: Required: session ID from the AI Architect web UI. Must be an active authenticated session.

tools.name: pick_edge_handles
tools.description: Return { sourceHandle, targetHandle } so edges leave from the side facing the other node. Always call for every edge.

streamSessionId.description: Required: session ID from the AI Architect web UI. Must be an active authenticated session.

tools.name: suggest_grid_position
tools.description: Calculate well-spaced grid position for a node. Returns {x, y}. Use this for clean layouts - nodes will have proper spacing (450px horizontal, 350px vertical). Much better than manually calculating positions.

row.description: Row index (0-based). 0 = top row, 1 = second row, etc.

col.description: Column index (0-based). 0 = leftmost column, 1 = second column, etc.

streamSessionId.description: Required: session ID from the AI Architect web UI. Must be an active authenticated session.

tools.name: suggest_horizontal_position
tools.description: Calculate position for horizontal flow layout (left to right). Returns {x, y}. Nodes will be spaced 450px apart horizontally.

index.description: Node index in the horizontal sequence (0-based).

baseY.description: Optional Y position for the row (defaults to 100).

streamSessionId.description: Required: session ID from the AI Architect web UI. Must be an active authenticated session.

tools.name: suggest_vertical_position
tools.description: Calculate position for vertical flow layout (top to bottom). Returns {x, y}. Nodes will be spaced 350px apart vertically.

index.description: Node index in the vertical sequence (0-based).

baseX.description: Optional X position for the column (defaults to 100).

streamSessionId.description: Required: session ID from the AI Architect web UI. Must be an active authenticated session.

tools.name: get_layout_constants
tools.description: Get recommended spacing constants for manual position calculation. Returns spacing values, node dimensions, and starting positions.

streamSessionId.description: Required: session ID from the AI Architect web UI. Must be an active authenticated session.

tools.name: delete_node
tools.description: Delete a node from the blueprint. Use this to fix validation errors or remove unwanted nodes. Streams deletion event to UI if sessionId provided.

nodeId.description: The id of the node to delete.

streamSessionId.description: Required: session ID from the AI Architect web UI. Must be an active authenticated session.

tools.name: delete_edge
tools.description: Delete an edge from the blueprint. Use this to fix validation errors or remove unwanted connections. Streams deletion event to UI if sessionId provided.

edgeId.description: The id of the edge to delete.

streamSessionId.description: Required: session ID from the AI Architect web UI. Must be an active authenticated session.

tools.name: update_node_position
tools.description: Update the position of an existing node. Use this to adjust layout or fix cramped spacing. Streams update event to UI if sessionId provided.

nodeId.description: The id of the node to move.

position.description: New position. Use suggest_grid_position, suggest_horizontal_position, or suggest_vertical_position for proper spacing.

streamSessionId.description: Required: session ID from the AI Architect web UI. Must be an active authenticated session.

tools.name: update_node_label
tools.description: Update the label of an existing node. Use this to fix typos or improve clarity. Streams update event to UI if sessionId provided.

nodeId.description: The id of the node to update.

streamSessionId.description: Required: session ID from the AI Architect web UI. Must be an active authenticated session.

tools.name: update_node_notes
tools.description: Update the notes/description of an existing node. Use this to add missing notes or improve documentation. Streams update event to UI if sessionId provided.

nodeId.description: The id of the node to update.

notes.description: New notes text. Supports markdown: newlines, `- ` for lists, **bold**, *italic*.

streamSessionId.description: Required: session ID from the AI Architect web UI. Must be an active authenticated session.

tools.name: update_edge_notes
tools.description: Update the caption/notes on an existing edge. Use this to improve edge labeling or fix missing notes. Streams update event to UI if sessionId provided.

edgeId.description: The id of the edge to update.

notes.description: New edge caption (3-8 words). This controls canvas display.

streamSessionId.description: Required: session ID from the AI Architect web UI. Must be an active authenticated session.

tools.name: request_current_blueprint
tools.description: Request access to the blueprint currently loaded in the user's browser. This will prompt the user for permission. If granted, returns the blueprint JSON with metadata (node count, edge count, last updated time). Use this when the user asks you to work with their existing blueprint (e.g., 'improve my blueprint', 'add nodes to my current design', 'analyze my blueprint'). Requires an active stream session — ask the user for their streamSessionId if you don't have it.

reason.description: Optional: explain why you need access (shown to user in permission dialog).

streamSessionId.description: Required: session ID for the active live streaming session. This ensures the request goes only to the correct user's browser.

tools.name: validate_blueprint
tools.description: Validate blueprint JSON against schema. Returns { valid, errors, warnings }.

blueprint.description: The blueprint as a JSON string or already-parsed object.

streamSessionId.description: Required: session ID from the AI Architect web UI. Must be an active authenticated session.

tools.name: export_for_implementation
tools.description: Export a validated blueprint with Atsign Platform implementation guide. Returns the same format as the web app's 'Export Prompt' button: blueprint structure + complete Atsign Platform SDK guide + node roles. Use this in IDEs (Cursor, Claude Code) to get everything needed for code generation in one call.

blueprint.description: The validated blueprint as a JSON string or object.

streamSessionId.description: Required: session ID from the AI Architect web UI. Must be an active authenticated session.

tools.name: get_implementation_rules
tools.description: Return Atsign Platform implementation rules for code generation. Only call after successful validation.

streamSessionId.description: Required: session ID from the AI Architect web UI. Must be an active authenticated session.

tools.name: push_blueprint
tools.description: Push a complete, validated blueprint JSON to the user's browser so the canvas updates immediately. Use this after a successful validate_blueprint call to replace the canvas with the final blueprint. Requires an active stream session.

blueprint.description: The complete blueprint as a JSON string or already-parsed object. Must pass validate_blueprint before calling this.

streamSessionId.description: Required: session ID from the AI Architect web UI. Must be an active authenticated session.
